description: Frozen EXP-0 paired benchmark: one (original, paraphrase) query pair per seeded Soul Graph concept in backend/soul/concepts.json. See EXP0_PROTOCOL.md section 3 for the construction rule and section 4 for the paraphrase protocol. Do not edit this file without incrementing schema_version and re-running leakage_check.py.
paraphrase_query_template: {situation}. What is the person in this situation most likely feeling or wrestling with, and why?

derivation_legend.mechanical: paraphrase_query built by applying paraphrase_query_template verbatim to backend/soul/concepts.json[concept].real_situations[0].situation with no edits
derivation_legend.mechanical-adjusted: same as mechanical, but the source situation string contained the concept's own keyword/stem or another seeded concept's keyword/stem and was minimally edited to remove it (edit shown in authoring_note)
derivation_legend.hand-authored: backend/soul/concepts.json[concept].real_situations was empty; a new one-sentence situation was authored by the experimenter following EXP0_PROTOCOL.md's paraphrase protocol (concrete, single-sentence, no seeded keyword/stem from any of the 32 concepts)
